```yaml
name: Main Build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - camel-4.10.x
      - camel-4.14.x

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java-version: [21]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java-version }}
          distribution: 'temurin'
      - name: Build with Maven
        run: mvn -B verify
```
